properties.name: codehunters.audit.enabled
properties.description: Whether the audit SDK is active. When false, no aspect, publisher, context provider or startup check is registered, and @Auditable methods are not audited.

properties.name: codehunters.audit.startup-check.fail-fast
properties.description: Whether a failed startup check stops the application: @Auditable methods without a publisher or without aspectjweaver, or an @Auditable expression that cannot be parsed. When false, each problem is logged as an error. Independent of fail-on-error.
